title: Classify handler: categorise records & route to staged batches

user_story.i_want: every record in a raw file categorised by product_type and data_type and grouped into one staged file per data_type
user_story.so_that: the transform stage receives homogeneous batches

description: `ClassifyHandler` implements MessageHandler. It parses the RawFileMessage and checks the ledger (if the file is already past `classified`, it acks and skips). It then decodes the file (STR-404) and, for each record: looks up the source (unknown or disabled goes to quarantine) and the catalog entry (unknown name goes to quarantine), removes `drop_fields`, checks `required_fields`, and enriches the record with product_type/data_type/tenant. Records are grouped per data_type. Each group is written as gzip NDJSON to a **deterministic** staged key, and one TransformMessage is sent per group. Finally it updates the ledger to `classified` with counts (total, classified, quarantined) and acks.

acceptance_criteria.given: a file mixing metric, event and log records
acceptance_criteria.then: 3 staged objects and 3 transform messages exist, and the counts add up to the total
the staged keys are identical and the ledger counts aren't doubled
the file succeeds and those records are counted as quarantined

acceptance_criteria.when: a record containing email is classified
acceptance_criteria.then: the staged record has no email field
the result is Retry, not Reject

rust_concepts: HashMap<DataType, Vec<_>> with the entry API
Moving vs borrowing records into groups
Composition: the handler holds Arc<dyn MetadataStore> etc.
